articles.author: Paul Johnson and Sarah Ferguson
articles.title: When Evan Gershkovich was arrested by the FSB he feared the worst
articles.description: Russia's FSB snatched US journalist Evan Gershkovich in a Yekaterinburg restaurant, what followed was life in a Russian jail cell and being part of a prisoner swap for an assassin.
articles.content:
Yekaterinburg, Russia, 2023. American journalist Evan Gershkovich is sitting in a restaurant talking to a source.
